product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Floor to Ceiling Mount for Menu Board Portrait and Landscape Display & Order Kiosk Fits 32 to 75 TVs
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Floor to Ceiling TV Mount for Menu Board Portrait and Landscape Displays & Order Kiosks, Fits 32" to 75" TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Floor to Ceiling TV Mount is designed for professional menu board displays and order kiosks where wall or ceiling mounting is impractical. It supports 32" to 75" TVs, anchors securely between the floor and ceiling, and provides a rigid, single-display solution for high-traffic commercial environments. This mount is ideal for restaurants, retail locations, and kiosks that require a clean vertical presentation without permanent wall construction.Floor-to-ceiling compression design enables installation without wall penetrationSupports 32" to 55" landscape displays and 43" to 75" portrait displays with a maximum load capacity of 66 lbs (30 kgs) per screenCompatible with VESA patterns from 100×100 to 400×400 mm for broad display compatibilityAdjustable display height with a maximum structure height of approximately 3100 mm (122.0 in)Ideal for glass-front locations, tiled walls, or areas where wall mounting is restrictedSteel construction with included anchors and fasteners for long-term rigiditySingle-display configuration suitable for menu boards, kiosks, and retail signageDesigned for indoor commercial use only; professional installation recommended FLOOR TO CEILING MOUNTING WITHOUT WALL PENETRATIONThe mount uses a floor-to-ceiling compression design, transferring load vertically between structural surfaces. This enables installation in glass-front locations, tiled walls, or areas where wall mounting is restricted. SUPPORTS LARGE COMMERCIAL DISPLAYSSupports 32" to 55" landscape displays and 43" to 75" portrait displays with a maximum load capacity of 66 lbs (30 kgs) per screen. Compatible with VESA mounting patterns from 100×100 to 400×400 mm, covering most commercial flat panel displays. ADJUSTABLE HEIGHT FOR OPTIMAL VIEWINGThe vertical support column allows display height adjustment, with a maximum structure height of approximately 3100 mm (122.0 in) to accommodate different ceiling heights and sightline requirements. COMMERCIAL GRADE STEEL CONSTRUCTIONAluminum, steel, and plastic construction with included anchors and fasteners provides long-term rigidity and resistance to movement.
